class.jaymoskingdoms.option.charm.desc: The person you look at takes you for a friend for a minute: no blows on you, kinder prices. A blow from you ends it. A held spell. A strong mind may shrug it off.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.command.desc: One word they must obey: Flee, Drop or Grovel. Pick the word on the Magic screen. Look at them, or send your familiar to touch them.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.suggestion.d: Whisper a short, harmless task to a villager or beast: come, wait, go away, sleep, or follow. Pick it on the Magic screen. Any harm ends it.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.hold.desc: Freezes a person where they stand for twenty seconds. They can still see. Blows on them hit hard. A held spell.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.zone_of_trut: A circle on the ground where nobody can lie. Judges and jailers raise one over those they question. A held spell; a dispel ends it.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.geas.desc: A sworn task laid on a captive, a sworn captain or one who cannot refuse. They cannot raise a hand to you, cannot stray far from you, and it hurts them to try. Three days.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.modify_memor: The villager you look at forgets the ill they hold of you, and keeps only a pleasant word. If their mind holds, they remember the tampering.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.locate_objec: Hold the thing you seek in your other hand. A thread of gold motes drifts toward the nearest like it, thicker the closer you come.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.locate_creat: With a lock of someone's hair in your pack, a thread of violet motes drifts toward them, thicker the closer you come.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.augury.desc: Throw the bones and face the road you mean to take. Gold light and a bright chime for good, dark smoke and a low bell for ill, both for a mixed fate, a dry clack for nothing. Right nine times in ten.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.scrying.desc: Beside a cauldron of water, with a lock of someone's hair in your pack, watch the ground around them in the bowl, as far as the land is loaded. They feel the watching. A held spell.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.plant_growth: Crops, saplings and berries where you look ripen as a whole season would at once. The farmland under them dries out.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.control_weat: A great rite, thirty seconds still with a book open, under the open sky: the weather turns to clear, rain or storm, as picked on the Magic screen, for half a day.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.moonbeam.des: A column of cold light where you look, held for half a minute. Whatever wears a false shape in it is forced into its true one: werewolves, and dragons walking as villagers. The walking dead burn in it.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.heroes_feast: Look at a table. A feast is laid on it. Everyone who eats there goes a day with no fear and no poison taking hold, and a little more health.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.find_familia: Binds a small spirit animal: an owl, cat, rat, raven or frog, picked on the Magic screen. Costs a lure it likes. Can be cast as a ritual.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.wild.desc: Wild blood. Your blade and bolt take a different element every time, and now and then a spell surges into something else: you glow, sheep fall from the sky, you turn blue, a fireball lands at your feet, everyone near is healed, you float. Never deadly, never dull.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.scry.title: Scrying: %s
message.jaymoskingdoms.rite.sky: The rite needs the open sky above you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rite.still: The weather does not move here.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.forgetting.0: Hm? I had a thought just now. It's gone.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.forgetting.1: Do I know you? You seem kind enough.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.forgetting.2: Strange. I had something to say to you, and it's gone.
